question: Why did the error rate go up on 16 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: Upstream search-cluster is the root cause of the error rate increase.
why_chain: The error rate in service search increased due to the upstream search-cluster returning HTTP 503.
The upstream search-cluster is the service that the search service calls, and it is experiencing issues.
The upstream search-cluster is the root cause of the error rate increase in service search.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase is due to a configuration change.
ruled_out.reason: There is no evidence of a configuration change that would cause the error rate to increase.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase is due to a sudden increase in user traffic.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume for service search did not change significantly, and the error rate increase is not correlated with a spike in user traffic.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase is due to a data quality issue.
ruled_out.reason: There is no evidence of bad or unusual input data causing the error rate increase.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase is due to infrastructure issues.
ruled_out.reason: There is no evidence of any infrastructure issues, such as network or server capacity problems.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service search rose from 0.41% to 4.35% (+948%), with a change point at 2026-03-16T11:05:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service search: 3 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.08).
At the same time, request volume for service search stayed about the same (2454 per 5 min before, 3034 per 5 min after, +24%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service search rose (140 ms before, 255 ms after, +82%).
Upstream search-cluster returning HTTP 503 for search (search; 3 min after the change; record R013)

search: ERROR upstream search-cluster timeout after 3 retries (search, eu-west; 14 min after the change; record R015)
search-cluster status page: investigating degraded performance (search; 30 min after the change; record R017)
search: ERROR upstream search-cluster timeout after 3 retries (search, us-east; 23 min after the change; record R016)

reasons: ✓ A change event (alerts) lines up in time (3 min after the change).
✓ 4 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.

actions.action: Investigate and fix the upstream search-cluster issue.
Monitor the upstream search-cluster and take preemptive actions if it shows signs of degradation.
Review and optimize the retry logic for the search service to handle upstream failures more gracefully.
